desc: Read the integer N and the string S from standard input.
Count the total number of '1's in the string, denoted as `cnt`.
Iterate through every possible starting index `i` from 0 to `N - cnt` (inclusive) representing the leftmost position of the contiguous block of '1's.

For each starting index `i`, calculate the cost: sum of absolute differences between the current index of each '1' and its target index within the block (i.e., `current_index - (i + k)` for the k-th '1').
Track and print the minimum cost found across all possible starting positions.
Collect indices of all '1's into a list `P`.
Determine optimal `l`: `mid = Q[len(Q)//2]`. Clamp `l` to `[0, N - len(Q)]`.
Calculate total cost: `sum(abs(p - (l + i)) for i, p in enumerate(P))`.
